title: cite answer
description: The memory tool cite's answer (SB-P4-10, migration 055; story 7): the memory cites a Drive document at the revision a check of it found now, never one the caller names. citation is the citation as get serves it, checked just now; created says this call made it, unchanged that the memory cited the document already (nothing moved: bringing it up to date is revalidate's). Nothing in the memory changed: its revision is the one it had. No document words, no memory words. Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body (held: a memory held for review; unknown_document: no such document on the map for the caller; source_unavailable: Drive could not give it now; invalid: not a Drive document, more than 20, or with scopes on a document wider than the memory's scope).
